raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct data series, likely representing outputs and residuals from attention and feed-forward components in a neural network. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," is also a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The legend identifies four data series: "attn_output" (blue dashed line), "attn_residual" (orange dotted line), "ffn_output" (green dash-dotted line), and "ffn_residual" (red solid line). The "attn_output" series remains at a value of 0 for layers 0 to 5, then rises sharply to a peak of approximately 200 at layer 22. The "attn_residual" series starts at 0, increases to a peak of approximately 1450 at layer 5, and then gradually decreases to a value of approximately 250 at layer 22. The "ffn_output" series remains at 0 for layers 0 to 5, then spikes to a peak of approximately 900 at layer 13, and subsequently decreases to a value of approximately 100 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" series remains at 0 for layers 0 to 5, then rises sharply to a peak of approximately 1550 at layer 14, remains high until layer 20, and then drops to a value of approximately 600 at layer 22.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The graph, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct data series: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 with integer increments, while the y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," spans from 0 to 1600 in increments of 200. The attn_output series is represented by a blue dashed line, which remains near zero until layer 22, where it sharply increases to a value of approximately 250. The attn_residual series is shown as an orange dotted line, starting at 0, rising steeply to a peak of about 1450 at layer 5, then remaining high with minor fluctuations until layer 21, where it drops sharply to around 250. The ffn_output series, depicted by a green dash-dotted line, stays near zero until layer 5, then spikes to a peak of approximately 1200 at layer 6, followed by a sharp decline and another smaller peak near layer 14, before stabilizing at a low value. The ffn_residual series is shown as a red solid line, which remains at 0 until layer 5, then rises sharply to a peak of about 1450 at layer 5, remains high until layer 21, and then drops abruptly to a value of approximately 500 at layer 22.
